CONFIRMED — every model-naming and isolation fact checks out verbatim: - GEN_Series_NA_
gotchas: Same "Canbus is enabled in Standby mode" sentence. Same non-answer.
IP68 and natural convection, 12 V only, up to 230 Ah per bank, -20 °C to +40 °C. These are the NOCO parts most plausible in a cabin battery box, and they are exactly the ones with nothing to read.
GENPRO10X4 is 40 A across four isolated 10 A banks — NOT 40 A into one bank. Sizing trap.
NOCO's GCP AC Ports are a plug-n-play AC extension accessory referenced on the GENPRO support page. Power only; not a data accessory.
